summary: This component renders a blog post with standard header, content, and footer sections. It conditionally includes a TypoReport component, but only when viewing the full blog post page rather than a preview or list.

explanations.4: This function accepts children (the content between the tags) and className (extra styling) as props.
explanations.5: useBlogPost() is a custom hook that fetches blog-related data; we're extracting metadata and a boolean flag that tells us if we're on the actual blog post page.
explanations.15: The && operator means 'only render TypoReport if isBlogPostPage is true'; this prevents showing the typo report on blog listing pages.
